items.title: NTSB investigating United 737 runway excursion at Denver
items.summary: The NTSB said it is investigating a runway excursion involving a United Airlines Boeing 737-8 at Denver International Airport during landing on July 25. No injuries were reported.

items.title: United jet slides off Denver runway, no injuries reported
items.summary: A United Airlines Boeing 737-8 slid off the runway while landing at Denver International Airport on Friday, the carrier said. All passengers deplaned safely.

items.title: United jet slides off Denver runway, no injuries reported (update)
items.summary: Updated wire copy of the Denver runway excursion story.

items.title: IATA: global air cargo demand up 8.2% in June
items.summary: The International Air Transport Association reported that global air cargo demand, measured in cargo tonne-kilometers, rose 8.2% in June 2026 compared with June 2025.

items.title: FAA statement on unruly passenger enforcement
items.summary: The FAA issued a statement on enforcement actions against unruly passengers.
